name: The Golden Bay Resort - Hotel Booking API
description:
Comprehensive hotel booking system API with user authentication, booking management, 
payment processing, room availability tracking, and admin dashboard.

## Features
- User authentication with JWT tokens
- Room availability checking and booking
- Payment processing with Stripe
- Admin dashboard and management
- Email notifications
- Review system
- Real-time availability updates

## Authentication
Most endpoints require authentication via JWT Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Admin endpoints require admin role permissions.
